title: apache/commons-lang#1585: ArrayUtils.subarray index arithmetic overflow
summary: A pull request that clamps `ArrayUtils.subarray`'s end index from below, because `end - start` could overflow to a positive size. The overflow was found: the old version runs out of memory where the new returns an empty array. The change was proved confined to the inputs where the subtraction overflows; a length property is unverifiable because JBMC treats an array of computed size as one of any length.
verdictLabel: ✗ the overflow found; ✓ change confined; ⚠ length property unverifiable
notes: The first attempt crashed the tool: the interpreter replaying JBMC's witness tried to allocate the two-billion-element array literally. It now raises `OutOfMemoryError` for absurd arrays, fixed in the same commit as the record.
The confined change is stated as "`end - start` overflows" written without the overflow: `startIndexInclusive > 0 && endIndexExclusive < startIndexInclusive - 2147483647 - 1`.
provenance: A real change to a published library, verified with the /verify-bytecode skill; the report is this folder's README.md.
